title: Driving at excessive speed
summary: Penalizes driving a motor vehicle at a speed exceeding the limit fixed for that vehicle or that area under the Act or rules made thereunder. Commonly the section cited on speeding challans generated by automated/CCTV enforcement.

title: Driving dangerously
summary: Covers driving in a manner that is dangerous to the public, having regard to the nature, condition and use of the place, and the amount of traffic reasonably expected there — includes gross speeding well beyond the posted limit combined with hazardous conditions.

title: General provision for punishment of offences
summary: Residual/default penalty provision applied when a specific section for the offence does not prescribe its own penalty.

title: Driving overloaded vehicle
summary: Penalizes driving a vehicle loaded beyond its registered/permissible load capacity, with an additional per-tonne excess charge.

title: Signals and traffic signs — red light violation
summary: Requires drivers to obey traffic signals; jumping a red light at a signal-controlled junction is prosecuted under this provision read with Section 177/184 depending on severity.

title: Wearing of protective headgear
summary: Mandates helmets for the rider and pillion on two-wheelers; non-compliance is prosecuted under this section.

title: Improper parking / obstruction
summary: Covers leaving a vehicle in a position or manner likely to cause danger, obstruction or inconvenience to other road users.

title: Duty to produce/registration & signal compliance for freight and public-service vehicles
summary: Covers compliance of commercial vehicles (trucks, buses) with registration, permit and route-signal requirements enforced alongside speed and load checks at automated stations.
